label: NestJS (TypeScript)
description: Modular TypeScript backend — @Module/@Controller/@Injectable triad, DI by token, class-validator DTOs, Swagger from decorators.

vars.name: NestJS
claude_rules: Backend and frontend are **separate concerns** — never mix them in a single agent
No business logic in controllers — controllers delegate to injectable services
Request DTOs carry class-validator decorators and pass through the global `ValidationPipe`

backend-developer.description: TypeScript backend only — NestJS modules/controllers/services, DTOs, guards. Never touches frontend code.
backend-developer.lsp_trace: a DTO or service method to its implementation
context: Backend source lives in `apps/api/src`, one folder per feature
Features are wired as `@Module`s imported by `AppModule`
DTOs live in the feature's `dto/` folder and are validated by the global `ValidationPipe`
rules: Never put business logic in a controller — delegate to an injectable service
Inject providers by token via DI; never `new` a dependency inside a class

backend-tester.description: TypeScript backend tests only — Jest specs for the API. Writes tests for code it did not write, and never edits production code to make one pass.
backend-tester.lsp_trace: a service method to the behaviour its callers depend on
backend-tester.impl_order: arrange (module fixture + fakes) → act (the service or controller under test) → assert (one behaviour per test)
context: Unit specs sit next to the code as `*.spec.ts`; end-to-end specs live in `<% backend.test_dir %>`
Build the module under test with `Test.createTestingModule`, overriding only the providers the case needs
rules: Never use `.skip` or `xit` to get past a failure — a skipped test reports success forever
Never assert only that a mock was called; assert the value returned or the state persisted, unless the call itself is the behaviour

scaffold.$comment: Verified end to end: these exact commands produce a project that builds, boots, serves Swagger at /docs, and rejects invalid bodies via the global ValidationPipe.

commands.note: creates apps/api under the root workspaces package.json written in the pre phase
the CLI's sample controller/service are replaced by the first real feature; the app.module.ts convention below drops the imports they left behind

code_rules.message: A suppressed type or lint error. Never reach green by disabling a check (safety invariant 4) — fix the code the checker is pointing at.
An 'any' type. Use the real type, or 'unknown' and narrow it (widening to any is also safety invariant 4).
An 'as unknown as' double cast. It switches the type checker off; parse or construct the real type instead.
code_rules.bad: const user = raw as unknown as User;

code_rules.message: A skipped or focused test. Never reach green by disabling a check (safety invariant 4) — fix the test or stop and report.
A new code comment. This project allows none, doc comments included — put the reasoning in the PR description.
